summary: Formula Systems filed a Form 6-K announcing a special cash dividend of $13.045 per share (~$200M total), approved by its board following the 2025 acquisition of Sapiens by Advent. The dividend record date is May 25, 2026, payable June 4, 2026, in USD for both ordinary shares and ADSs. Subject to Israeli withholding tax (25% or 30%), the distribution reflects strong cash generation and portfolio performance. What to watch: execution of payment mechanics and any tax implications for non-Israeli holders; no risk-arb angle as this is a direct shareholder return.
